learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to use fun little magic words like He, She, and It instead of repeating names!
warm_up_hook: 📖 Meet my friend Rohan. Rohan is a boy. Rohan loves to play. Wait, saying Rohan again and again is boring! Let us use magic words to make our sentences sound much better.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use the word 'He' when we talk about one boy or man. Your father, your brother, and your grandpa are all 'He'.
examples: Rohan is a boy. He likes to play.
My father is strong. He loves me.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use the word 'She' when we talk about one girl or woman. Your mother, your sister, and your grandma are all 'She'.
examples: Sita is a girl. She is dancing.
My mother is kind. She cooks yummy food.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use the word 'It' when we talk about an animal, a bird, or a thing. Your pet dog, your toy, and your pencil are all 'It'.
examples: I have a ball. It is round.
Look at the cat. It is sleeping.

practice_quiz.question: ❓ Rahul is my best friend. ___ plays football with me.
❓ My sister is very sweet. ___ loves eating ice cream.
❓ Look at this big apple. ___ is red and juicy.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Family Pointing Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Point to your family members and loudly say 'He' or 'She'. Then point to your toys or pets and say 'It'!

chapter_summary: ⭐ 'He' is the special word for boys and men.
⭐ 'She' is the special word for girls and women.
⭐ 'It' is the special word for animals, birds, and non-living things.
